summary: The filing is an 8-K by KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC reporting its transactional net asset values per share across nine share classes as of May 31, 2026. Values range from $34.58 (Class R-U) to $37.74 (Class G and H). The NAV is used for sales and repurchases of shares. No transaction, merger, tender, or corporate action is announced. The disclosure is routine periodic reporting of fund performance metrics. No special-situation event is present. The filing includes no deal terms, advisor involvement, or board recommendation regarding any change-in-control or restructuring. It is a standard current report on financial condition.
